the quality of Web applications is a key factor in their acceptance by the market and, as such, it should be considered in the early stages of the development process.

the quality management activities proposed in this work can be integrated into a WE process in a way that is not only compatible with the semi-automatic nature of the WE process, but also that is not perceived as an additional cost by the developer.

the quality of Web applications can be improved by integrating the quality assessment in the development process.
